items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I was making $75.00 a week playing with George Clarke Carr

ctx.x: Yes, it was. Well, the fact of the matter is I'll tell you the strange thing about it is I was influenced to come there because of my love for music strictly,

strictly music love. Because in those days the money was very little, in fact I was making $75.00 a week playing with George Clarke Carr, and I was influenced to come to join Lester Young for $55.00 a month -- a week.
